text: Create a session via SDK call tied to a specific end user
Exposes a small set of meta-tools that let an agent discover, authorize, and execute tools across apps at runtime instead of loading every tool definition
quote: Composio exposes **7 meta-tools** that let the agent discover what's available, authorize apps on demand, and execute tools across apps in parallel.

text: Session creation can be scoped to specific toolkits to restrict which tools an agent can access
quote: To restrict the set, pass `toolkits` when you create the session.

text: Sessions can expose a hosted MCP server by passing an mcp flag, giving a remote MCP endpoint without deploying infrastructure
quote: Opt into MCP by passing `mcp: true` when you create the session. The session then exposes its hosted MCP server.

text: MCP flag can be combined with a direct-tools preset to serve one MCP URL limited to a specific list of tools
quote: Combine `mcp: true` with the direct-tools preset to get one MCP URL that serves exactly the tools you list

text: Agent can post a Connect Link in-conversation so the user authenticates and the tool call resumes, with no custom auth UI needed
quote: The agent posts the Connect Link straight into the conversation. The user clicks it, signs in, and the agent retries the tool and continues. No auth UI for you to build.

text: Supports a callback_url to redirect users back to the host app after completing authentication
quote: To send users back to your app after they connect, pass a `callback_url`

text: Connect/auth pages can be white-labeled with custom logo, name, and full restyling
quote: You can swap in your logo and name, then restyle the whole page to match your product.

text: Delivers every trigger event to a single registered webhook URL, signed for verification
quote: Composio delivers every event to one destination you control: your webhook URL. You register it once per project, and Composio `POST`s every trigger event there, signed so you can verify it.

text: Official CLI gives coding agents and terminal users a local tool surface to connect apps, execute tools, inspect schemas, and debug
quote: The Composio CLI gives coding agents and terminals a local tool surface. Codex, Claude Code, or a person at the terminal can connect apps, execute tools, inspect schemas, call authenticated APIs, and debug Composio projects.

text: CLI can install a native plugin that integrates Composio directly into Codex or Claude Code
quote:
Install the native plugin for Codex or Claude Code:

composio setup --target auto

text: Provider adapters convert Composio tools into the native tool format expected by a given agent framework, avoiding custom glue code
quote: A provider is the adapter that turns Composio tools into the native tool format your framework expects, so you don't write glue code.

text: Composio Connect lets any existing MCP-compatible client reach a shared hosted MCP URL without creating an SDK session
quote: Use Composio Connect when you already have an MCP-compatible client and want the shared Composio MCP URL, without creating an SDK session.

text: Provides a remote sandbox tool to run Python for bulk operations or to process large tool responses
quote: COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH** — Run Python in a remote sandbox for bulk operations or processing large tool responses.
